Thanks — I’ll be on the call. A few technical constraints so the MAP can be scoped correctly:
- Network: we currently limit egress IP ranges; we prefer a site-to-site VPN terminated at our appliance (no inbound peering).
- KMS: Nebula uses AWS KMS with external key import (BYOK); we can provide a key import workflow but require proof of zero-key retention on Redwood’s side.
- Auditing: we need delivery of token-level request logs for 30 days and an ingestion hook to our SIEM (Splunk).

Andre will join the kickoff; I’ve asked him to bring the exact CIDR blocks and VPN cipher requirements. Carlos will validate the audit log format.

One more: can Redwood confirm whether the private deployment option supports an air-gap pattern (no internet-facing endpoints) or whether we should plan for a controlled egress tunnel?

-Matthew
Director, Cloud Operations | Nebula Health
